rca_of_the_issue: PRIMARY 1 (trophy next-up) — Original bug: HomeTrophyCase.tsx computed nextUpId with useMemo but never passed it to <BadgeCard/>. Fix: pass `isNextUp={b.id === nextUpId}` on line 134. Verified: exactly 1 chip with data-testid=`badge-champion-next-up` (champion has highest ratio 20% among unearned). PRIMARY 2 (testimonial next click occluded) — Original bug: right-side floating progress rail overlapped the next chevron at 1920px, intercepting real mouse clicks; force=True bypassed actionability but the click still targeted the overlay. Fix: home FlatList contentContainerStyle paddingRight:196 when showProgressRail (width>=1450) shifts the whole content 196px to the LEFT, moving the testimonial card (and its next arrow at right-edge x=1655) safely away from the rail (rail starts at x=1736). Verified: rail vs next bounding boxes no longer intersect, elementFromPoint at next-btn center closest-testid resolves to `testimonial-next`, real mouse click advances counter 1/13→2/13 and swaps the testimonial content. PRIMARY 3 (zero-value hero stats) — Original bug: platform stats (0+ active users, 0% perf boost, 0+ AI sessions today, 0+ global coaches) rendered as dead values in the hero. Fix: `.filter((s) => Number(s.value) > 0)` on statCards + conditional render of hero-stats-grid only when statCards.length > 0. Verified: only 1 non-zero card ('Utilisateurs actifs 735+') renders inside [data-testid=hero-stats-grid].
